name: Glowbloom Moth
summary: A moth as big as a cart wheel whose wings hold a slow, pulsing glow.
description: Glowbloom moths drift above the forest at dusk, drinking the nectar of night-flowering trees. Their wing powder shines for hours, and woodland children dare each other to walk out of a glade still wearing it.

traits.name: Luminous Wings
traits.text: The moth sheds Bright Light in a 20-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 20 feet. Creatures that can see the moth have {ref:glossary/disadvantage} on Wisdom (Perception) checks to notice anything outside the light.

actions.name: Dazzling Powder
actions.onFailure: , and the target has the {ref:condition/blinded} condition until the end of the moth's next turn.
